overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、资产定价（1 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（1 篇）。方法上以实验方法、模型校准为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、Semantic Scholar（5 篇）。

papers.title: Generative Marketing Mix Modeling: A Causal Inference Framework Linking GEO and GEM to Business Impact
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence changes how firms reach customers, but standard marketing data do not record how often users see and notice a firm's name in generated answers. We develop Generative Marketing Mix Modeling (GMMM) to estimate the causal effects of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Generative Engine Marketing (GEM). For GEO, GMMM combines repeated generated answers with question counts, shares of use across generative systems, and notice probabilities. For GEM, it combines records of sponsored placements with notice probabilities. GMMM compares expected business responses under alternative treatment sequences and establishes sufficient conditions for identifying the resulting effects. We investigate the empirical performance of the proposed method using simulated answers to product recommendation in English and Japanese.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】生成式人工智能改变了企业与客户互动的方式，但传统的营销数据并未记录用户在生成式回答中看到或注意到企业名称的频率。我们提出了“生成式营销组合模型”（Generative Marketing Mix Modeling，简称GMMM），用以评估生成式引擎优化（Generative Engine Optimization，简称GEO）和生成式引擎营销（Generative Engine Marketing，简称GEM）的因果效应。在GEO模型中，GMMM将用户生成的重复回答与问题被提及的次数、不同生成系统中的使用频率以及用户注意到这些回答的概率相结合进行分析；而在GEM模型中，则将企业发布的赞助内容记录与用户注意到这些内容的概率结合起来进行分析。该模型通过比较不同处理方案下的预期商业反应，确立了识别这些效应所需的充分条件。我们利用英语和日语产品推荐的模拟数据，对所提出方法的实证效果进行了验证。。研究方法：广义矩估计、优化方法。

papers.title: Entropic Value-at-Risk parity for tempered stable returns
papers.abstract: We develop Entropic Value-at-Risk (EVaR) parity for tempered stable returns. EVaR-based inverse risk parity (IRP) and equal risk contribution (ERC) portfolios are constructed using multivariate normal tempered stable models and independent component analysis with tempered stable components. We derive the corresponding asset-level EVaR and EVaR-deviation contributions and use the latter to separate the fitted location term from EVaR risk contributions. Under Gaussian returns, EVaR-deviation IRP and ERC recover conventional volatility IRP and ERC weights. We evaluate the resulting portfolios in three investment universes. Empirically, EVaR-based ERC portfolios achieve positive Sharpe differences relative to equal weight across the universes.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】我们为具有“温和稳定性”特性的资产回报开发了基于熵风险的估值方法（Entropic Value-at-Risk，简称EVaR）的帕累托排序（parity）。基于EVaR的逆向风险帕累托（Inverse Risk Parity，简称IRP）和等风险贡献（Equal Risk Contribution，简称ERC）投资组合是通过使用多元正态分布模型以及包含“温和稳定性”成分的独立成分分析（Independent Component Analysis）构建的。我们推导出了相应的资产层面EVaR值及其偏差贡献，并利用后者将模型拟合得到的位置效应（location effect）与EVaR风险贡献区分开来。在高斯分布假设下，基于EVaR的IRP和ERC投资组合能够恢复传统的波动率相关权重。我们在三个不同的投资环境中对构建的投资组合进行了评估。实证结果表明，在所有投资环境中，基于EVaR的ERC投资组合相较于等权重投资组合均实现了更高的夏普比率（Sharpe Ratio）。。

papers.title: Formation of an integrated model of partnership interaction in the entrepreneurial ecosystem of rural green tourism
papers.venue: Ukrainian Journal of Applied Economics and Technology
papers.abstract:
The article substantiates the theoretical and methodological foundations for developing an integrated model of partnership interaction within the entrepreneurial ecosystem of rural green tourism. Fragmented interaction among business entities, territorial communities, public authorities, and support institutions has been shown to constrain the integrated use of local resources, access to external finance, knowledge transfer, and the implementation of joint projects. The study applies theoretical generalization and systematization, systems and structural-functional analysis, comparative analysis, and structural-logical modeling. The functional integration of cluster and network mechanisms is substantiated. The cluster mechanism provides territorial and economic integration, service bundling, the development of an integrated tourism product, and a local value chain. In contrast, the network mechanism expands access to knowledge and competencies, financial and grant resources, digital technologies, and external partners. The educational and research center and the digital platform are identified as complementary elements of the coordination and communication framework. The scientific novelty lies in an integrated model that combines territorial-economic cooperation, network interaction, knowledge- and competence-based support, digital coordination, project-based cooperation, monitoring, performance evaluation, and feedback. The model is adaptive to a territory’s resource potential, tourism specialization, and institutional capacity. Its practical significance lies in its potential use by business entities, territorial communities, and public authorities to coordinate entrepreneurial initiatives, develop integrated tourism products and local value chains, attract external resources, and implement joint projects. The proposed approach lays the groundwork for transforming fragmented actors into an adaptive rural green tourism entrepreneurial ecosystem focused on creating economic, social, and territorial value.

Keywords: rural green tourism, entrepreneurship, entrepreneurial ecosystem, partnership interaction, cluster mechanism, network mechanism, territorial communities, integrated tourism product, local value chain, digital platform.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本文确立了在农村绿色旅游创业生态系统中构建合作伙伴关系互动综合模型的理论基础和方法论依据。研究发现，企业实体、地方社区、公共部门和支持机构之间的互动缺乏协同性，这限制了当地资源的综合利用、外部融资的获取、知识转移以及联合项目的实施。研究采用了理论概括与系统化方法、系统与结构功能分析、比较分析以及结构逻辑建模等研究手段，证实了集群机制与网络机制在功能上的互补性。集群机制促进了地域与经济的整合、服务体系的构建、综合旅游产品的开发以及地方价值链的形成；而网络机制则拓展了获取知识与能力、资金与补助资源、数字技术以及外部合作伙伴的渠道。教育与研究中心及数字平台被认定为协调与沟通框架中的关键组成部分。该模型的创新之处在于它整合了地域经济合作、网络互动、基于知识和能力的支持体系、数字协调机制、项目合作模式、绩效评估与反馈机制，能够根据地区的资源禀赋、旅游发展特色及机构能力进行灵活调整。其实践意义在于：企业实体、地方社区和公共部门可借助这一模型协调创业活动，开发综合旅游产品与地方价值链，吸引外部资源，并推动联合项目的实施。该方法为将分散的各方力量整合为一个具有经济、社会和地域价值的适应性农村绿色...。

papers.title: Deconstructing and Reconstructing University Classroom Authority in the Age of Generative AI: Practical Reflections on a Project Based Learning Reform
papers.venue: Journal of Education Teaching and Social Studies
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of generative artificial intelligence is fundamentally reshaping higher education, challenging the traditional lecture-based, knowledge-transmission model of classroom instruction. This paper offers a reflective analysis based on the author's first-hand teaching experience at a Chinese university with a finance and economics focus, where two AI-related courses are offered: a general-education AI literacy course for all undergraduates and an advanced deep learning course for computer science majors. The analysis reveals that AI, as a near-perfect knowledge transmitter, has rapidly devalued the knowledge-delivery function of traditional classrooms. Teachers find themselves caught between the narrowness of their own specialised training and the explosive, fast-moving breadth of AI, while student engagement continues to decline. In response to this crisis, the author's school officially launched a teaching reform in the spring semester of 2026, shifting its core approach from "knowledge-point instruction" to "project-based learning" (PBL). For the general-education course, which enrols a large number of students from social science and humanities backgrounds, the reform emphasises individual creation using off-the-shelf AI tools, aims at developing a perceptual understanding of AI principles, and involves minimal or no coding. For the computer science majors, in contrast, the advanced course adopts more technically intensive, code-based projects. This paper describes in detail the initial implementation and emerging challenges of this differentiated reform, and reflects on the necessity and pathways for transforming the teacher's role from "knowledge authority" to "learning environment designer."
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】生成式人工智能的迅速发展正在从根本上重塑高等教育，挑战着传统的以讲授为主、以知识传递为核心的课堂教学模式。本文基于作者在中国一所专注于金融与经济领域的大学的教学经验进行了深入分析。该校开设了两门与人工智能相关的课程：一门面向所有本科生的通识性人工智能素养课程，另一门则是针对计算机专业学生的进阶深度学习课程。分析表明，作为一种近乎完美的知识传递工具，人工智能极大地削弱了传统课堂在知识传递方面的作用。教师们发现自己既受限于自身专业培训的局限性，又难以跟上人工智能领域快速发展的步伐；与此同时，学生的课堂参与度持续下降。为应对这一挑战，该校于2026年春季学期正式启动了教学改革，将教学方法从“知识点传授”转变为“项目式学习”（Project-Based Learning, PBL）。对于面向社会科学和人文学科背景学生的通识课程，改革强调学生使用现成的人工智能工具进行自主创作，旨在帮助他们建立对人工智能原理的直观理解，且几乎不涉及编程内容；而对于计算机专业的学生，则采用更具技术难度、以编程为主的项目。本文详细介绍了这一差异化改革的初步实施情况及其面临的挑战，并探讨了将教师角色从“知识权威”...。研究方法：深度学习。

papers.title: Utility-Level-Dependent Ambiguity
papers.abstract: Experimental evidence suggests that ambiguity-sensitive choice can vary systematically with the circumstances of a decision. This paper isolates one channel within a stable preference relation: ambiguity weighting may depend on the act's certainty-equivalent level. After the standard Anscombe-Aumann calibration of consequence utility, a set of behavioral axioms yields a unique continuous family of normalized monotone capacities $\{ν_v\}_{v\in(0,1)}$. Each nonendpoint act is evaluated by the Choquet integral associated with the capacity at its own interior certainty-equivalent level, while nonendpoint acts on the same indifference surface share the same capacity. Binary event comparisons identify local event weights at each elicited level and trace their cross-level variation, providing tests of the fixed-capacity restriction. Local uncertainty aversion is equivalent to convexity of $ν_v$ and yields an implicit multiple-priors representation with certainty-equivalent-indexed local cores. Certainty translation invariance holds if and only if the capacity is fixed across levels, recovering the maintained nondegenerate fixed-capacity Choquet expected utility benchmark; global mixture-betweenness yields implicit additive utility, and imposing both restrictions recovers full-support subjective expected utility. The capacity schedule is a reduced-form ambiguity weighting whose variation may reflect changes in ambiguity perception, ambiguity attitude, or both.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】实验证据表明，对模糊性的敏感程度会随着决策情境的不同而系统性地发生变化。本文在一种稳定的偏好关系中识别出一个关键因素：模糊性权重可能取决于某一行为的“确定性等价水平”（即该行为在多大程度上可以被视为确定的）。在对后果效用进行标准的Anscombe-Aumann校准之后，一组行为公理能够推导出一组唯一的、连续的、标准化的单调容量函数$\{ν_v\}_{v\in(0,1)}$。每个非端点行为都会根据其对应的确定性等价水平所对应的Choquet积分来进行评估；而位于同一无差异曲线上的非端点行为则共享相同的容量函数。通过比较二元事件，可以确定在各个诱发水平下的事件权重，并追踪这些权重在不同水平间的变化情况，从而检验“固定容量限制”这一假设是否成立。局部不确定性厌恶程度与容量函数$ν_v$的凸性密切相关；这种凸性特征使得$ν_v$能够以一种隐式的、基于确定性等价水平的表示方式进行描述。当容量函数在不同水平上保持不变时，才满足“确定性转换不变性”这一条件，此时即可恢复原有的、非退化的、基于固定容量的Choquet期望效用模型；而“全局混合性”特征则使得效用函数具有隐式的加性性质；同时满足这两...。研究方法：模型校准、实验方法。

papers.title: Deep Learning of Robust Market Making under Regime-Switching Order Flow
papers.abstract: Classical market-making strategies based on stochastic control, such as the Avellaneda-Stoikov and the Guéant-Lehalle-Fernandez-Tapia (GLFT) extension, provide closed-form quoting rules, but rest on assumptions that break down at realistic microstructure timescales. One of them is that order flow is stationary, while empirical evidence points to the existence of regimes, possibly associated with algorithmic execution of metaorders. In this case, existing methods provide negative PnL. In this paper, we develop a deep reinforcement-learning market maker (RLMM) - a Rainbow-style distributional DQN (C51) which is calibrated and tested in a zero-intelligence limit order book. We find that, in the stationary setting, RLMM outperforms GLFT across the entire observed risk-return frontier. The RLMM is more robust to flow asymmetry than GLFT, but, like any stationarily trained strategy, it still suffers large drawdowns from inventory saturation under persistent directional imbalance. Augmenting the state of RLMM with two auxiliary signals - a Bayesian online change-point filter over the directional flow bias and a queue-adjusted quote-exposure imbalance -restores profitability. A final scenario-bandit step that reweights low-return regime scenarios further improves performance under random-persistence and correlated-direction stress.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】基于随机控制的经典做市策略（如Avellaneda-Stoikov模型和Guéant-Lehalle-Fernandez-Tapia（GLFT）扩展模型）能够提供封闭形式的报价规则，但这些策略建立在某些假设之上，而这些假设在现实的微观结构时间尺度下并不成立。其中一个关键假设是订单流是平稳的，然而实证证据表明订单流存在周期性变化，这可能与算法执行元订单（meta-orders）有关。在这种情况下，现有策略会导致负的利润损失（PnL）。在本文中，我们开发了一种基于深度强化学习（Deep Reinforcement Learning, RL）的做市模型——即Rainbow风格的分布式DQN（C51）算法，并在零智能水平的限价订单簿环境中对其进行了校准和测试。研究发现，在平稳假设下，RLMM在观测到的整个风险-回报范围内均优于GLFT。与GLFT相比，RLMM对订单流的非对称性具有更强的适应性；然而，像所有基于平稳假设训练的策略一样，当市场出现持续的方向性失衡时，RLMM仍可能因库存饱和而遭受较大的损失。通过引入两个辅助信号来增强RLMM的状态——一个是用于检测方向性流动偏误的贝叶斯在线...。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、模型校准、随机过程。

papers.title: Short-maturity skew stickiness ratio under local volatility
papers.abstract: We prove that the skew stickiness ratio converges to two at short maturity under local volatility models. This appears to be the first rigorous proof of this limit for a general time-dependent local volatility function. As a by-product, we strengthen the one-half rule of the implied volatility skew by removing uniform ellipticity and global bounds on spatial derivatives of order at least two. The proof uses a first-order Watanabe expansion.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们证明了在局部波动率模型下，当到期时间较短时，偏粘性比率会收敛至2。这似乎是针对一般时变局部波动率函数的首个严格证明。作为一个副产品，我们通过消除均匀椭圆性以及对空间导数至少二阶的全球性约束，加强了隐含波动率偏度的“二分之一规则”。该证明采用了Watanabe的一阶展开方法。。

papers.title: Market-Informed Networks for Modeling and Forecast Evaluation of Financial Extremes
papers.abstract: Modeling the joint distribution of extreme values in high-dimensional financial time series is challenging because extremes are sparse and locally extreme observations are not necessarily extreme relative to their full marginal distribution. To address this, we introduce a time-dependent network Hüsler-Reiss model in which market-informed adjacency matrices determine how strongly observations contribute to the estimation. We propose binary and weighted specifications, including the Joint Extremes Adjacency Matrix (JEAM) which combines information about individual extremeness with historical patterns of joint extreme movements. In the forecasting evaluation part, covering one-minute stock returns from three sectors of the S&P 100, JEAM achieves the best out-of-sample log scores for both tail directions; improving scores by 12.5-13.6% in the lower tail and 11.4-14.9% in the upper tail. The results show that incorporating market-informed network structures in the estimation, improves forecast evaluation of extremes across time series.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在高维金融时间序列中，对极端值的联合分布进行建模是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为极端值较为罕见，且局部极端观测值并不一定在其完整的边际分布中属于极端值。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了一个基于时间依赖性的网络模型——Hüsler-Reiss模型。在该模型中，市场信息驱动的邻接矩阵决定了各个观测值对极端值估计的贡献程度。我们提出了两种模型规格：二进制规格和加权规格，其中联合极端值邻接矩阵（Joint Extremes Adjacency Matrix, JEAM）结合了关于单个观测值极端性的信息以及极端值联合运动的历史模式。在预测评估部分，通过对标普100指数中三个行业的分钟级股票回报数据进行测试，JEAM在两个尾部方向上都取得了最佳的样本外对数评分：在低尾部提升了12.5%-13.6%，在高尾部提升了11.4%-14.9%。研究结果表明，在估计过程中融入市场信息驱动的网络结构，能够有效提升时间序列中极端值的预测效果。。研究方法：时间序列。

papers.title: Social Preferences and Cooperation: Beliefs, Robustness, and the Limits of Altruism
papers.abstract: We study a mechanism of cooperation in the Prisoner's Dilemma (PD). Incorporating social preferences as efficiency concerns into the PD game, we study how altruism translates into cooperation. Under complete information, cooperation requires the opponent's altruism to clear a threshold. We then introduce a subjective extension of Bayesian Nash equilibrium that relaxes the Common Prior Assumption, letting players hold heterogeneous, potentially misspecified beliefs about each other's altruistic type. Cooperation then depends on beliefs about altruism rather than altruism itself, and can be sustained even when opponents are, on average, only weakly altruistic. When fear of exploitation dominates the temptation to defect, beliefs about the opponent's cooperation become strategic complements, so a cooperative and an uncooperative equilibrium can coexist under identical payoffs and an identical, correctly specified prior. Using multiplier preferences, we then study how robust this belief-driven cooperation is to model misspecification. Cooperation is fragile: it survives only above a threshold level of confidence in one's own belief, and can unravel even when the belief itself correctly supports cooperation. As a formal extension, the same robust-control apparatus, applied to a player's action choice, nests Nash equilibrium, Bayesian Nash equilibrium, and logit Quantal Response Equilibrium as limiting cases. Cooperation depends less on how altruistic agents are than on what they believe about each other, and how confident they are that this belief is right.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了囚徒困境（Prisoner’s Dilemma, PD）中的合作机制。通过将社会偏好（表现为效率考量）纳入囚徒困境模型，我们探讨了利他主义如何转化为合作行为。在信息完全透明的情况下，合作行为的实现需要对手也表现出足够的利他主义倾向。随后，我们提出了一种对贝叶斯纳什均衡（Bayesian Nash Equilibrium）的主观扩展模型，该模型放宽了“共同先验假设”（Common Prior Assumption），允许玩家对对方的利他主义类型持有异质性且可能存在误判的信念。因此，合作行为的持续性不再仅仅取决于利他主义本身的存在，而是取决于玩家对利他主义的认知；即使对手平均而言利他主义倾向较弱，合作依然有可能维持。当对被剥削的恐惧超过背叛的诱惑时，玩家对对手合作行为的信念会成为策略性互补因素，从而在收益相同且先验信息准确的情况下，合作与非合作均衡能够共存。通过引入“乘数偏好”（multiplier preferences）机制，我们进一步研究了这种基于信念的合作机制对模型误设的鲁棒性。研究发现，合作行为非常脆弱：它只有在玩家对自己信念的信心达到一定阈值以上时才能维持；即便...。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、均衡模型。

papers.title: Beyond Code Generation: Reliability, Verification, and Cost Economics in the Agentic Software Development Lifecycle
papers.abstract: AI coding systems are moving from autocomplete and chat toward agents that can inspect repositories, edit multiple files, run tools, write tests, open pull requests, and work for long periods with limited supervision. This capability changes the bottleneck in software delivery. Recent field studies show meaningful gains in coding activity, but newer evidence also shows that those gains attenuate sharply between writing code and shipping reliable software. Review, integration, testing, security, deployment, and production operations remain constraining stages, while the economics are shifting from predictable per-seat licensing toward variable token, tool, sandbox, CI, and rework costs. This paper synthesizes peer-reviewed software-engineering research, university studies, benchmark audits, production reports from major technology companies, developer telemetry, and cost-management evidence released primarily from 2024 through September 2026. No new model experiment is claimed; numerical findings remain attributed to their original studies. The synthesis proposes four engineering concepts: the Agentic SDLC Throughput Paradox, Production-Qualified Change (PQC), the Verification Tax, and an Agentic SDLC Control Plane that allocates autonomy subject to cost, reliability, and human-attention budgets. An evidence-based horizon then maps today's supervised agents to future policy-bounded software factories. The central research question shifts from how much code an agent can generate to how much production-qualified value an engineering system can deliver per dollar, per reviewer-hour, and per unit of operational risk.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】人工智能编码系统正从自动完成代码和提供聊天支持的功能，发展为能够自主检查代码库、编辑多个文件、运行工具、编写测试用例、处理拉取请求，并在有限监督下长时间工作的智能代理。这种能力显著改变了软件交付过程中的瓶颈。最近的实地研究表明，编码效率确实有所提升，但新的证据也显示，从编写代码到交付可靠软件的过程中，效率提升的效果会大幅减弱。代码审查、集成、测试、安全保障、部署以及生产运维等环节仍然存在诸多限制。同时，软件经济的模式正在发生变化，从传统的按用户数量计费的模式，转向基于令牌、工具使用量、沙箱环境、持续集成（CI）以及返工成本等多种因素的灵活定价方式。本文综合了来自同行评审的软件工程研究、大学研究、大型科技公司的生产报告、开发者数据以及主要在2024年至2026年9月期间发布的成本管理数据。本文并未提出任何新的模型实验，所有数值结果均来源于原始研究。综合分析提出了四个关键工程概念：代理式软件开发生命周期（SDLC）的效率悖论（Agentic SDLC Throughput Paradox）、生产合格度标准（Production-Qualified Change, PQC）、验证成本（...。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Digitalisation of Cultural Heritage and the Economics of Cultural Tourism: Transforming Preservation into Opportunity
papers.venue: Digital Presentation and Preservation of Cultural and Scientific Heritage
papers.abstract: The digitalisation of cultural heritage represents one of the most significant transformations in contemporary cultural policy and tourism economics. This paper examines the intersection of digital technologies—including 3D scanning, virtual and augmented reality, artificial intelligence, and blockchain—with the preservation, accessibility, and economic valorisation of cultural heritage. Drawing on case studies from major institutions such as the Louvre, the British Museum, and innovative projects like Rome's Circo Massimo Experience, we analyse how digitalisation creates economic value across the complete tourist journey: from pre-visit inspiration through on-site enhancement to post-visit engagement. The paper addresses the fundamental tension between heritage as a preservation cost and heritage as an economic opportunity, arguing that digital technologies offer solutions that simultaneously increase revenue, expand accessibility, and reduce physical strain on fragile sites. However, significant challenges remain, including the digital divide, technological obsolescence, questions of authenticity, and ethical considerations regarding ownership and representation. We conclude with a framework of principles for responsible digital heritage development and recommendations for cultural institutions seeking to navigate this transformation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】文化遗产的数字化是当代文化政策与旅游经济领域最具影响力的变革之一。本文探讨了数字技术（包括3D扫描、虚拟现实、增强现实、人工智能和区块链）在文化遗产的保护、可访问性及经济价值转化中的作用。通过分析卢浮宫、大英博物馆等知名机构的案例，以及罗马Circo Massimo Experience等创新项目，我们研究了数字化如何在整个旅游过程中创造经济价值——从游客出行前的信息获取，到现场体验的优化，再到出行后的互动交流。文章指出了遗产保护与经济价值之间的根本矛盾，认为数字技术能够在增加收入、提升可访问性的同时，减轻对脆弱文化遗产的物理损害。然而，仍存在诸多挑战，如数字鸿沟、技术更新换代、真实性问题，以及关于遗产所有权和呈现方式的伦理考量。最后，本文提出了负责任地发展数字文化遗产的原则框架，并为相关文化机构提供了应对这一变革的建议。。

papers.title: Economics of Vermicompost, Vermicompost Tea, and Azadirachtin Nanopesticide for Integrated Nutrient and Pest Management for Sustainable Crop Rotations
papers.abstract: Sustainable fresh sweetcorn-based rotations require nutrient- and pest-management inputs that are both agronomically effective and economically feasible. This study evaluated vermicompost (VC) and vermicompost tea (VCT) as nutrient-management inputs and an azadirachtin nanopesticide as a potential threshold-based pest-management intervention within an integrated management framework. Previously published agronomic, soil, fall armyworm, and nanopesticide data were used; no new field or efficacy experiments were conducted. The analysis compared VC-only, VCT-only, and integrated VC + VCT enterprises; developed partial budgets for the 2022 fresh sweetcorn–strawberry and 2024 fresh sweetcorn–soybean rotations; assessed VCT application intensity; and separately evaluated the economics of annualized nanopesticide production and price sensitivity. Under retail-market assumptions, VCT-only and VC + VCT production were economically favorable, with cost–benefit ratios (CBR) of 3.15 and 1.91, whereas VC-only production did not recover annual costs. In 2022, only the fertilized control and VC1 recovered the included fresh sweetcorn variable costs under six VCT applications, and VC1 generated the strongest subsequent strawberry and rotation-level returns. In 2024, VCT20 and VCT40 produced the highest fresh sweetcorn yields and achieved complete fall armyworm suppression, but neither fresh sweetcorn treatment nor a full rotation recovered the included costs. Subsequent soybean production generated positive partial-budget returns, with VC1 + VCT20 performing best. Lowering VCT volume or frequency increased the number of modeled scenarios that reached partial-budget break-even, while observed yield was held constant. Nanopesticide production generated an estimated annual net profit of USD 4378, a 3.1% margin, and a CBR of 1.032. Because the nanopesticide was not applied in the rotations, its integration remains prospective. These results should also be interpreted considering small-plot yield extrapolation, deterministic price assumptions, partial budgeting, and the availability of only two fresh sweetcorn experiments. These findings support moderate VC use, further field validation of lower-intensity VCT schedules, and evaluation of threshold-triggered nanopesticide intervention within an integrated decision-support framework.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】可持续的以新鲜甜玉米为基础的轮作系统需要既具有农艺效果又经济可行的养分管理和害虫管理措施。本研究评估了蚯蚓堆肥（VC）和蚯蚓堆肥茶（VCT）作为养分管理手段的效果，并探讨了印楝素纳米杀虫剂在综合管理框架中的潜在应用价值（尤其是基于害虫发生阈值的控制策略）。研究数据来源于先前的农艺研究、土壤分析、关于秋粘虫的研究以及纳米杀虫剂的相关资料，未进行新的田间试验或效果验证。分析内容包括：单独使用VC或VCT的情况，以及VC与VCT结合使用的模式；制定了2022年新鲜甜玉米-草莓轮作和2024年新鲜甜玉米-大豆轮作的部分预算；评估了VCT的施用剂量；并分别分析了纳米杀虫剂生产的经济效益及其对价格变化的敏感性。
